scientific.integrity: The proof is algebraic from the published update equations. A standard-library checker reconstructs the recurrence and checks the trace/determinant identities on rational test cases plus the stated numerical examples. Finite checks supplement but do not replace the proof.
scientific.limitations: Exact scalar two-block strongly convex quadratics only; assumes \(\min\{a,b\}<\beta<\max\{a,b\}\) and one common relaxation \(\alpha\in(0,1)\). No claim is made for general matrix problems, unequal relaxations, or nonquadratic objectives.

title: Critical-damping relaxation for scalar strictly contractive Peaceman–Rachford splitting
